subject: Asterion Therapeutics - private offer MAP + procurement timeline
messages:
From: Sophia Kapoor <sophia.kapoor@asteriontx.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Exploring private offer options and timeline

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for taking the call yesterday. Asterion is preparing an accelerated evaluation and procurement track for Q3 and we want to understand Redwood's private-offer + marketplace path (GCP preferred). Key asks:

- A mutual action plan (MAP) we can run against internal eval milestones (security sign-off, perf eval, procurement PO).
- Typical GCP private-offer billing path and estimated invoicing cadence (monthly vs. upfront commit options).
- Procurement/contract steps your customers usually follow for a Marketplace private offer.

We have a hard internal target to be on contract by 2028-07-18 to align with our board spending window. Can you send a draft MAP and any required procurement artifacts? I've attached a short RFP excerpt.

Attachments: Asterion_RFP_Q2.pdf (1 page)

Thanks,
Sophia Kapoor
Director, Digital Platforms
Asterion Therapeutics
procurement@asteriontx.com

On Tue, Jun 12, 2028 at 09:12 AM Sophia Kapoor wrote:
> Initial RFP excerpt attached for context.
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia Kapoor <sophia.kapoor@asteriontx.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring private offer options and timeline

Hi Sophia — great to connect. Putting a short, deadline-driven MAP below so your procurement and product teams have something to react to. I copied Lauren (onsite for legal/finance handoffs) and Marcus (solutions engineer) to cover technical acceptance criteria.

Draft MAP (timeline to hit 2028-07-18 target)
- Day 0 (today): Draft MAP shared; confirm cloud (you mentioned GCP) and projected committed spend.
- Day 2: Redwood sends private-offer pricing grid + standard PO terms (we'll mark non-negotiables).
- Day 5-7: Security questionnaire follow-up + SOC2 evidence pack exchange.
- Day 8-12: Technical eval (Marcus leads perf tests; we provide a 2-week trial env + sample prompts).
- Day 13-18: Commercial signoff & DocuSign of Private Offer; AWS marketplace private-offer activation.
- Post-sign: Onboarding kick (redwood-run kickoff + onboarding checklist).

Procurement notes:
- Typical GCP private offer flow: customer receives offer via marketplace, signs DocuSign commitment with Marketplace PO ID; billing goes to your billing account and we reconcile via marketplace invoices. Upfront commit vs. monthly consume are both possible — we'll include both options in the pricing grid.

Action items for Asterion:
- Confirm GCP as your preferred cloud and an expected 12-month ARR range for pricing.
- Share preferred PO approver + billing contact.

I'll attach the MAP draft (v1) and a high-level price breakdown; Lauren can surface any legal items. If this timeline looks tight, we'll scope a minimal acceptance run to validate perf quickly.

Attachments: MAP-draft-asterion-v1.docx, price_breakdown_Q2.xlsx

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Manager, Marketplaces & Enterprise
Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

On Tue, Jun 12, 2028 at 10:05 AM Priyom Das wrote:
> Draft MAP attached (v1) — open to edits.
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Asterion pricing guardrails + approval path (confidential)

Lauren/Marcus — quick sync notes after Sophia's RFP:

- Target close date: 2028-07-18 (board-aligned). We should be prepared to offer a 6-12 month commit with a 10-15% onboarding credit if they sign within 30 days.
- Pricing sensitivity around per-token vs. committed unit rates -> propose blended committed tiers.
- Legal: minimal redlines on data residency and audit logs. We can provide SOC2 evidence and an IP carve-out statement; Lauren, please confirm if we need an addendum for on-prem telemetry.
- Billing path: recommend Marketplace private offer (GCP) with invoicing to Asterion's billing account; finance will reconcile via monthly marketplace invoices. If procurement insists on a direct Redwood invoice, add 4% admin fee.

Marcus — can you draft a 3-day perf acceptance plan we can ship to them this week? Short checklist: cold-start latency, 95th p99 latency target, infra cost estimate for trial.

I'll include a conservative uplift on pricing until legal signs off.

— Priyom
From: AWS Marketplace Sales <marketplace-sales@aws.amazon.com>
To: Sophia Kapoor <sophia.kapoor@asteriontx.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Asterion private offer activation steps (GCP equivalent)

Hi Sophia / Priyom / Lauren,

Thanks — quick note from the marketplace side. For private offers that will be billed through GCP, the equivalent steps are:

1) Redwood creates the private offer record in the Marketplace console and shares the offer ID with Asterion.
2) Asterion accepts the offer via the DocuSign flow (we can also provide a Marketplace acceptance URL).
3) Once accepted, the offer is tied to your billing account and monthly invoice reconciliation begins.

Private-Offer ID (placeholder): PO-672914-AST
Required marketplace artifacts: signed private-offer DocuSign + procurement POC email confirming billing account.

If you need a backlog-friendly path, we can also enable a 30-day trial entitlement to run the technical acceptance tests before chargeable consumption. Please advise if the team wants the trial enabled by default.

Regards,
Janelle Harris
Channel Specialist, Marketplace Programs
AWS Marketplace
marketplace-sales@aws.amazon.com

Thanks all — this looks good and aligns with our timeline. We confirm:

- Cloud: GCP (Confirmed).
- Target commit: 12-month term, ballpark $450k ARR (we'll firm numbers by EOD).
- Acceptance path: please enable the 30-day trial entitlement so Marcus can run perf tests immediately.
- Procurement: I'll route the DocuSign to our PO approver by Monday; target to have signed PO by 2028-07-15 to leave a small buffer.

Next steps (as I see them):
1) Redwood sends updated MAP (v2) including the trial entitlement and the two commercial options (monthly consume vs. 12-month commit).
2) Marketplace rep to confirm private-offer activation & provide final private-offer ID.
3) Marcus to schedule perf kick (preferably next Tue/Wed).

Thanks — excited to move forward.

Regards,
Sophia Kapoor
Director, Digital Platforms
Asterion Therapeutics
